source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: Yellow signs provide a general warning.
corrections.note: Removed slow down and stay alert which the page does not state.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: The octagon requires a full stop at an intersection controlled by the stop sign, while the equilateral triangle means yield the right of way.
corrections.note: Removed claim that both control intersections.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: The pennant is on the left side of the road and warns of a no passing zone, while the diamond warns of special road hazards.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop at the stop line and wait until crossing vehicles and the crosswalk are clear before proceeding, pulling forward when necessary, while a yield sign means you must slow down and yield the right of way.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported two-point visibility maneuver language and restored the stop line rule.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: School buses charter buses drivers carrying passengers for hire and vehicles placarded for hazardous materials must stop within fifteen to fifty feet of railroad tracks before crossing unless a police officer or highway traffic signal directs traffic to proceed or the crossing is marked with an exempt sign.
corrections.note: Added missing stopping distance and exceptions for officer direction and exempt signs.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Skateboards and scooters are example pedestrian conveyances using human powered devices and vehicles must yield the right of way to people using them.
corrections.note: Removed claim they are not vehicles which the page does not state.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield lines are a row of solid white triangles pointing toward approaching vehicles that mark where to yield for yield signs, yield here to pedestrians signs, and yield here to pedestrians and bicycles signs.
corrections.note: Added the missing yield here to pedestrians and bicycles sign type.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: On a road with two or more lanes in the same direction the left lane is generally used for passing, and you must never drive on the shoulder unless instructed by a traffic control device or an official and must never pass on the shoulder whether paved or not.
corrections.note: Added shoulder exception and corrected precisely to generally.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: If changing lanes is impossible or unsafe you must slow to a reasonable and proper speed for the conditions and violating the law may suspend your license for up to one year.
corrections.note: Changed mandatory full year to may be suspended for up to one year.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Under Iowa hands free law you must not hold or manually touch your phone and you may call text or dial only with hands free or voice activation but you must never stream videos or make video calls even with voice commands and covered electronic devices include cell phones PDAs tablets gaming devices and laptops.
corrections.note: Added that video streaming and video calls stay banned even with voice commands.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: At forty miles per hour keep a four to five second following distance and use six or more seconds when roads are slippery or the vehicle ahead blocks your view.
corrections.note: Changed past forty to at forty miles per hour to match the page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: At forty miles per hour keep a four to five second following distance and use six or more seconds when roads are slippery or the vehicle ahead blocks your view and for antilock brakes press the brake pedal as hard as you can and keep pressing.
corrections.note: Corrected gap to four to five seconds at forty and six or more only for slippery or blocked view.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Fifty miles per hour applies on unsurfaced secondary roads from sunset until sunrise and for all trucks on secondary roads at any time and sixty miles per hour applies on all primary roads and urban interstate highways and secondary roads including unpaved roads from sunrise to sunset and seventy miles per hour applies on rural interstate highways and a lower limit may be set for any of these conditions.
corrections.note: Added missing unsurfaced and day night and truck qualifiers for the limits.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: When changing lanes, be sure to check the far lane if there is one because someone in that lane may plan to move into the same lane you want to enter.
corrections.note: Replaced vague hiding language with the actual far lane same lane reason.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Farm vehicles horse drawn vehicles ATVs UTVs and roadway maintenance vehicles normally travel slower and may have an orange triangle or flashing lights on the back so spot them early to change lanes or slow down safely because slowing suddenly can cause a crash.
corrections.note: Added that the sign only may be present and can be flashing lights, not only an orange triangle.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Almost half of all flash flood deaths happen in vehicles and as little as six inches of water may sweep away a vehicle including sport utility vehicles and pickups so never drive through a flooded road or bridge but turn around and find a different route and abandon a stalled flooded vehicle and move to higher ground.
corrections.note: Corrected most to almost half and float trucks to sweep away a vehicle including sport utility vehicles and pickups.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: On narrow rural gravel roadways slow down and move as far to the right as safe to do so when meeting oncoming vehicles and be prepared to stop for oncoming traffic at narrow bridges that can only accommodate one vehicle at a time.
corrections.note: Corrected demand full stops to be prepared to stop for oncoming traffic.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: Never leave children elderly persons dependent persons or pets alone in an enclosed vehicle because the inside can soar above one hundred sixty degrees in less than ten minutes and can reach one hundred degrees in minutes even on a mild seventy eight degree day and in Iowa it is legal to break a vehicle window to provide medical attention to a person or animal trapped inside.
corrections.note: Added less than ten minutes timing and mild day one hundred degrees detail and who must not be left.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export

corrections.corrected_statement: When signaled to stop, pull over to a clear safe area out of the travel lane, turn off your vehicle, keep your hands visible on the steering wheel, remain calm and follow instructions.
corrections.note: Removed the unsupported claim about arguing because no provided page mentions arguing.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized four-state export
